views.name: public_catalog_partner_branches
views.definition:
SELECT b.id,
    b.name,
    b.address,
    s.catalog_slug
   FROM (partner_branches b
     JOIN store_settings_v2 s ON ((s.user_id = b.user_id)))
  WHERE ((s.catalog_enabled = true) AND (s.catalog_slug IS NOT NULL) AND (b.is_active = true));

views.name: public_catalog_partner_profiles
views.definition:
SELECT p.business_name,
    p.account_name,
    s.catalog_slug
   FROM (partner_profiles p
     JOIN store_settings_v2 s ON ((s.user_id = p.id)))
  WHERE ((s.catalog_enabled = true) AND (s.catalog_slug IS NOT NULL));

views.name: public_catalog_products
views.definition:
SELECT p.id,
    p.branch_id,
    p.name,
    p.sale_price,
    p.image_url,
    p.stock,
    p.category,
    p.sku,
    p.is_service,
    s.catalog_slug
   FROM ((partner_products p
     JOIN store_settings_v2 s ON ((s.user_id = p.user_id)))
     JOIN partner_branches b ON (((b.id = p.branch_id) AND (b.user_id = p.user_id))))
  WHERE ((s.catalog_enabled = true) AND (s.catalog_slug IS NOT NULL) AND (b.is_active = true) AND (p.stock > 0));

views.name: public_catalog_store_settings
views.definition:
SELECT catalog_slug,
    catalog_enabled,
    logo_url,
    banner_url,
    primary_color,
    nav_color,
    business_hours
   FROM store_settings_v2
  WHERE ((catalog_enabled = true) AND (catalog_slug IS NOT NULL));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.partner_employee_can_access_branch(p_company_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from public.partner_salespeople sp join public.partner_branches b on b.id=p_branch_id and b.user_id=p_company_id where sp.user_id=p_company_id and sp.auth_user_id=auth.uid() and coalesce(sp.active,true) and (sp.role='administrador' or sp.branch_id=p_branch_id)); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.partner_rma_company_access(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.partner_profiles pp
    where pp.id = p_company_id and pp.id = auth.uid()
  )
  or exists (
    select 1 from public.partner_salespeople ps
    where ps.user_id = p_company_id
      and ps.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and coalesce(ps.active, true) = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION partner_subscription_private.guard_collaborator_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM partner_subscription_private.require_collaborator_module(TG_ARGV[0]);
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION partner_subscription_private.require_collaborator_module(p_feature text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE feature text:=CASE WHEN p_feature='estoque' THEN 'cadastros' ELSE p_feature END;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_salespeople WHERE auth_user_id=auth.uid() AND active=true AND feature=ANY(blocked_modules))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso a este módulo bloqueado pelo administrador.'; END IF;
END; $function$
